tools.name: weekdone_get_company
tools.description: Get the company settings: reporting schedule, timezone, template and which objective levels are used. Weekdone API: GET /1/company.

tools.name: weekdone_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams in the company with their ids, names and report privacy. Use the team ids in other tools. Weekdone API: GET /1/teams.

tools.name: weekdone_list_users
tools.description: List the users in the company with their ids, names, admin flag and teams. Weekdone API: GET /1/users.

tools.name: weekdone_list_types
tools.description: List the report categories (item types) with their ids and names, for example 0 = Plans on hold, 1 = Progress, 2 = Plans, 3 = Problems and custom types. Use the id as type_id when creating items. Weekdone API: GET /1/types.

tools.name: weekdone_search_items
tools.description: Search the report items (progress, plans, problems and custom items) of one week, filtered by user or team. Defaults to the current week. Weekdone API: GET /1/items.

tools.name: weekdone_get_item_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one report item. Weekdone API: GET /1/item/{id}/comments.

tools.name: weekdone_get_report
tools.description: Get the weekly report data grouped by team, with each user's items, rate and ratings. Defaults to the current week. Weekdone API: GET /1/report.

tools.name: weekdone_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags used on items, with their priority status and latest status text. Weekdone API: GET /1/tag.

tools.name: weekdone_list_objectives
tools.description: List OKR objectives (company, department, team or user level) with their progress and key results. Weekdone API: GET /1/objective.

tools.name: weekdone_list_kpis
tools.description: List the company, department and team KPIs with their current value, type and range. Weekdone API: GET /1/kpi.

tools.name: weekdone_create_item
tools.description: Create a report item (a plan, progress, problem or custom item) in a week. Changes Weekdone data. Weekdone API: POST /1/item. Not retried on failure.

tools.name: weekdone_update_item
tools.description: Change the text, category, priority or due date of a report item. Changes Weekdone data. Weekdone API: PATCH /1/item/{id}. Moving an item to another type_id also needs period.

tools.name: weekdone_assign_item
tools.description: Assign a report item to another user. Changes Weekdone data. Weekdone API: PATCH /1/item/{id}/assign.

tools.name: weekdone_add_item_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a report item. Changes Weekdone data. Weekdone API: POST /1/item/{id}/comments.

tools.name: weekdone_update_kpi_progress
tools.description: Set the current value of a KPI. Changes Weekdone data. Weekdone API: POST /1/kpi/{id}/progress.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: weekdone_get_item_comments · Public sink: weekdone_create_item, weekdone_add_item_comment, weekdone_update_kpi_progress.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: weekdone_get_item_comments · Public sink: weekdone_create_item, weekdone_add_item_comment, weekdone_update_kpi_progress

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
